body.x: Loudby(www.loudby.com), a patented innovation company for enhancing and directing speaker sound in small devices, unveiled "Sound Case" at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.LoudBy's unique sound channel inside the case amplifies sound by directing sound towards the listener and enhances the audio experience to a new level. There is no need for extra speaker boxes, cables or batteries. The novel patent pending implementation of sound outlet duct improves maximum sound pressure level up to 12 dB, therefore, low frequencies become stronger and highest frequencies become crispier.
